title: Top designers in SF now make $300K, here's why
description:
More about AI in my community, link in bio.

Top product designers in San Francisco are pulling up to $300K a year, and these aren't senior roles, just regular designers. Market average sits around $120K.

AI made code cheap. Anyone can ship a product now, so the value moved from writing code to having taste. Knowing what's actually worth building, and making something that feels human in a sea of identical AI templates.

As a founder I see it in my own hiring. Used to look for the fastest coder, now I look for sharp eye and real product instinct. Taste is the most valuable skill in tech right now.

#AI #productdesign #founder #hiring #startups
